responsibility: This target configuration header defines the static machine model for GCC’s eBPF port. It supplies driver specs, preprocessor builtins hook selection, data layout and ABI properties, hard-register numbering and classes, calling-convention and stack conventions, addressing and cost macros, assembler syntax details, symbol/output directives, pointer and scalar mode choices, and target limitations such as the lack of indirect-call-based constructors, thereby describing how generic GCC code should treat the BPF architecture before instruction selection.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the other same-stem BPF files, this header is the compile-time target configuration contract for generic GCC code, defining machine macros, ABI/layout rules, register classes, and assembler conventions. It does not implement backend logic like bpf.cc, encode instruction-selection patterns like bpf.md, or declare command-line options like bpf.opt.
